items.name: Cisco Networking Academy, Skills for All

desc.en: Offers free certification-aligned courses in topics like cybersecurity, networking, and Python.
desc.zh: 提供与认证对齐的免费课程，涵盖网络安全、网络、Python 等主题。

desc.en: Free, open-source AWS certification practice exams with 1,050+ questions for CLF-C02. Features timed mock exams, domain practice, spaced repetition, and progress tracking.
desc.zh: 免费、开源的 AWS 认证模拟考试，为 CLF-C02 提供 1,050+ 道题目。特性包括计时模拟考试、领域专项练习、间隔重复和进度跟踪。

desc.en: AI coding tutor that teaches you on your own codebase and never writes the code for you. Free tier: 10 in-browser lessons/month, Python/JS run client-side, no card required.
desc.zh: AI 编程导师，基于你自己的代码库教学，绝不替你写代码。免费套餐：每月 10 节浏览器内课程，Python/JS 在客户端运行，无需银行卡。

desc.en: Free short courses from industry-leading experts to get hands-on experience with the latest generative AI tools and techniques in an hour or less.
desc.zh: 行业顶尖专家提供的免费短课程，在一小时内动手体验最新的生成式 AI 工具和技术。

desc.en: Free, self-paced training for the Cisco DevNet Expert / CCIE Automation certification. Covers Python Click and Flask-RESTx.
desc.zh: 面向 Cisco DevNet Expert / CCIE Automation 认证的免费自定进度培训。涵盖 Python Click 和 Flask-RESTx。

desc.en: Free online guides for learning Django as their first framework & gives free dofollow backlink to articles written by users.
desc.zh: 免费在线指南，帮助学习者将 Django 作为第一个框架学习；并为用户撰写的文章免费提供 dofollow 反向链接。

desc.en: Offers access to over 4,000 free online courses from 250 leading institutions, including Harvard and MIT, specializing in computer science, engineering, and data science.
desc.zh: 可学习来自 250 所顶尖院校（含 Harvard 和 MIT）的 4,000+ 门免费在线课程，专注于计算机科学、工程和数据科学。

desc.en: Free, open-source programming education in over 75 programming languages, with human mentoring. A nonprofit organisation.
desc.zh: 免费、开源的编程教育，覆盖 75+ 种编程语言，提供真人导师指导。非营利组织。

desc.en: Free platform with lots of Resume templates of Experienced Professionals, ready to clone and edit fully and download, ATS optimized.
desc.zh: 免费平台，提供大量资深职场人简历模板，可完整克隆、编辑并下载，针对 ATS 优化。

desc.en: Open-source platform offering free courses and certifications in Data Analysis, Information Security, Web Development, and more.
desc.zh: 开源平台，提供数据分析、信息安全、Web 开发等免费课程和认证。

desc.en: Free university-level course on modern web development with React, Node.js, GraphQL, TypeScript, and more. Fully online and self-paced.
desc.zh: 免费的大学级现代 Web 开发课程，涵盖 React、Node.js、GraphQL、TypeScript 等。完全在线，自定进度。

desc.en: AI-powered resume builder with real-time editing and ATS optimization. Free tier includes automatic CV conversion to premium templates (Harvard, Europass), PDF export, job tracker with unlimited job posting insights and CV sharing with chat/voice features.
desc.zh: AI 驱动的简历构建器，支持实时编辑和 ATS 优化。免费套餐包含自动将简历转换为高级模板（Harvard、Europass）、PDF 导出、带不限职位发布洞察的求职追踪器，以及具备聊天/语音功能的简历分享。

desc.en: Free online guides for learning basic and advanced HTML/CSS, JavaScript and SQL.
desc.zh: 免费在线指南，学习基础和高级 HTML/CSS、JavaScript 和 SQL。

desc.en: Develop skills in Linux, DevOps, Cybersecurity, Programming, Data Science, and more through interactive labs and real-world projects.
desc.zh: 通过交互式实验和真实项目培养 Linux、DevOps、网络安全、编程、数据科学等技能。

desc.en: MIT OpenCourseWare is an online publication of materials from over 2,500 MIT courses, freely sharing knowledge with learners and educators around the world. Youtube channel can be found at [@mitocw](https://www.youtube.com/@mitocw/featured)
desc.zh: MIT OpenCourseWare 是 2,500+ 门 MIT 课程资料的在线发布平台，与全球学习者和教育者免费分享知识。YouTube 频道可在 [@mitocw](https://www.youtube.com/@mitocw/featured) 找到

desc.en: Free, open-source resume builder with dozens of templates. Exports to PDF, DOCX and also provides a publicly shareable link to the resume (opt-in).
desc.zh: 免费、开源的简历构建器，提供数十种模板。支持导出 PDF、DOCX，还可生成公开可分享的简历链接（可选开启）。

desc.en: Free learning roadmaps covering all aspects of development from Blockchain to UX Design.
desc.zh: 免费学习路线图，覆盖从 Blockchain 到 UX 设计的开发方方面面。

desc.en: Free, open-source platform with a curriculum focused on JavaScript and Ruby for web development.
desc.zh: 免费、开源平台，课程专注于 Web 开发的 JavaScript 和 Ruby。

desc.en: Offers free tutorials on web development technologies like HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and more.
desc.zh: 提供 HTML、CSS、JavaScript 等 Web 开发技术的免费教程。

desc.en: Learn the Linux terminal, Git and Vim in a simulated terminal in the browser. All 129 lessons are free; the first lesson of each course needs no account.
desc.zh: 在浏览器模拟终端中学习 Linux 终端、Git 和 Vim。全部 129 节课程免费；每门课程的第一节无需账户。
